description: A listed name covers its subdomains, not look-alikes. DNS for a.b.c2.example.net matches c2.example.net; notc2.example.net and c2.example.net.example.test do not. An HTTP Host of login.phish.example.org:8080 matches phish.example.org (listed as *.phish.example.org) once the port is stripped.
